title: Cloud-ready packaging

code_scope.Dockerfile: python:3.14-slim L7-only image, non-root user, healthcheck, L7_DB on /data volume; sealed layers are NOT baked in (mounted ro at runtime)
code_scope.docker-compose.yml: l7-backend + optional medgemma (Ollama) services; sealed L3–L6 mounted read-only; l7data volume; 127.0.0.1 bind + TLS-front guidance; .env secret contract
code_scope..dockerignore: keeps local data/build artifacts out of the image
code_scope.backend/scripts/backup.py: VACUUM INTO snapshots of L3–L7 (online-consistent) + retention (keep N newest)
code_scope.backend/l7/admin/export_delete.py: per-user export (L7 rows + L6 snapshot, deterministic, no secrets) and delete (FK-safe order; upstream deletion documented as sealed-layer-owner action)
code_scope.DEPLOYMENT.md: VPS path, MedGemma remote option, freshness degradation note, backup/restore, secret-handling review, cost controls

phase_h_cases: prod env refuses boot without L7_API_TOKEN
packaging smoke: prod-like app boots headless; dev token rejected (401); prod token served (200)
backup -> restore round-trip opens snapshot with L7 tables; retention prunes to keep=1
post-seal hardening: same-second backup runs get unique snapshot dirs (no VACUUM INTO collision); suite re-verified 89/89 twice
export contains user data and no secret material
delete removes all L7 rows and leaves SEALED upstream untouched

acceptance_gate.backend_deployable_independently: PASS (image contains only L7; compose defines full runtime incl. model host)
acceptance_gate.dev_pc_not_required: PASS by construction: all runtime deps (API, dbs, models) live on the VPS; app points at the VPS URL
acceptance_gate.freshness_degrades_gracefully: PASS (Today always serves latest judgment with 数据截至 stamp; verified in Phase D payload contract)

docker_note: Docker is not installed on the development PC (Phase A discovery). The one remaining confirmation is `docker compose up -d --build` on the target VPS; everything it runs is covered by the packaging smoke tests on this machine.
